# dsh-global-rules
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for visual editing of the user-level global rules file.
Directly manage your user-global instruction file `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` (default `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`)
from the Web Settings panel, avoiding the hassle of manually searching for hidden system directorie
rom the Web Settings panel, avoiding the hassle of manually searching for hidden system directories.
## Features
- **Sidebar Integration**: Adds a clean "Global Rules" section to the Settings panel, seamless with

DSH UI.
- **Dynamic Path & Reveal in File Manager**: Resolves the exact system path automatically, f
eaturing a "Show in Folder" button that highlights the file in Windows Explorer, macOS Finder, or Li

nux file managers.
- **Complete Editing Experience**: Monospace editor with Save / Cancel actions, s

upporting one-click undo and auto-creation if the file does not exist.
- **Immediate Effect**: New s
essions apply new rules instantly; current sessions detect changes on the next filesystem tool opera

tion.
- **Minimalist Architecture**: Built on Connection Fetch routes and native ModuleLoader, with
zero redundant third-party runtime dependencies.
